checks.evidence: Run against public preview URL https://noi-leyni--0yh202aj.preview.emergentagent.com: POST /api/auth/login with admin@leinivolley.it/Admin2026! -> response content-type application/json, body user.role=admin; browser navigated to /admin.

checks.criterion: If the host answers /api with HTML (missing proxy/rewrite) the app fails loudly instead of silently not redirecting
checks.name: login-proxy-missing-shows-toast
checks.evidence: page.route intercepted POST /api/auth/login to return 200 text/html (<!DOCTYPE html>...). Clicking login-submit-button showed toast text matching /l.indirizzo \/api non arriva al backend/i and the app stayed on /login.

checks.criterion: Production build proxy: build + `PORT=4555 yarn start` serves SPA and proxies /api
checks.name: production-build-proxy-manual
checks.evidence: cd /app/frontend && DISABLE_VISUAL_EDITS=true DISABLE_EMERGENT_OVERLAY=true yarn build (succeeded, dist/ produced) && PORT=4555 BACKEND_URL=localhost:8001 yarn start (vite preview). curl http://localhost:4555/admin -> 200 HTML. curl -X POST http://localhost:4555/api/auth/login (admin creds) -> 200 JSON {user:{role:admin}} with Set-Cookie: lv_session=...; curl http://localhost:4555/api/auth/me with that cookie -> 200 JSON user. Preview server killed and frontend/dist removed afterwards (no leftover artifacts).

checks.criterion: Board merges a duplicate athlete (transactions+family move, duplicate inactive+merged_into; same id 400; repeat 409; merchant 403)
checks.name: test_tscheck_athlete_merge.py
checks.evidence: Registered two tscheck-merge-* athletes via /auth/register/athlete. POST /admin/athletes/merge same keep_id==merge_id -> 400. Merchant (pizzeria@example.it) -> 403. Real merge (admin) -> 200 {kept.id, transactions, family}. Repeat merge of same merge_id -> 409. GET /athletes?status=all&q=<suffix> shows duplicate row is_active=false, merged_into=keep_id. 1 test, passed.

checks.criterion: Board merges a duplicate athlete — Admin UI merge dialog
checks.name: admin-athlete-merge-dialog-flow
checks.evidence: Created tscheck-uimerge-keep/dup-<ts> athletes via page.request (then logged out). Logged in as admin, Atleti tab, status filter 'Tutti', searched suffix, clicked admin-athlete-merge-<code> on the dup row -> merge-dialog opened, selected keep account in merge-keep-select, clicked merge-confirm -> toast 'Unito in ...' shown, dup row now shows 'Unito' badge.
